name: WHITE LINE NIGHTMARE
source:
Maggie and Mourgan are moving in together! It's an eight hour drive from rural Illinois to Pittsburgh, and these two lovers are meeting up in person for the first time. Will they be normal about being locked in a hatchback all day?

[From [url=https://harmful-park.itch.io/white-line-nightmare]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛吉和摩根要搬到一起同居啦！从伊利诺伊州的乡间一路开往匹兹堡需要整整八个小时的车程，而这对恋人也是第一次在线下奔现。被困在一辆掀背车里共度一整天，她们真能表现得像普通人一样正常吗？

[摘自[url=https://harmful-park.itch.io/white-line-nightmare]itch.io[/url]]
